mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_registry (id,asset_key,s3_object_key,public_url,sha256,bytes,category,status,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{assetKey},#{s3ObjectKey},#{publicUrl},#{sha256},#{bytes},#{category},'ACTIVE',0,NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE s3_object_key=VALUES(s3_object_key), public_url=VALUES(public_url),sha256=VALUES(sha256),bytes=VALUES(bytes), category=VALUES(category),status='ACTIVE',version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT asset_key FROM asset_registry WHERE category=#{category} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_registry SET status='RETIRED',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE asset_key=#{assetKey} AND status='ACTIVE'
